lines.en: So, did you, uh, did you tell Ross?
But then he had a shampoo-related emergency.
So I guess now it's your turn again.
No, no, no, no, no, no. I think it's better if you tell him.
You know, it's easier for a woman.
That way, you know, if he gets mad, all you have to do is go,
All right, all right, okay, um, how 'bout this? How 'bout this?
Tomorrow we'll both go, and we'll tell him together.
That just means, though, once again, we can't --
I know, I know. That's okay.
I mean, we can control ourselves. We're not animals.
All right, so I guess that means goodnight, then.
